entry.summary: Sentencing for murder and attempted murder under ss 172 and 173 of the Crimes Act 1961. On the charge of murder, the Court sentenced the defendant to life imprisonment with a minimum period of imprisonment of 13 years and three months. On the charge of attempted murder, the Court sentenced the defendant to a concurrent sentence of five years' and ten months' imprisonment.
